description: Create a new personal API token for the 'admin' user named 'automation-token'. Save the generated token value to '/home/ga/api_token.txt'. Then, use this token to authenticate a curl request to the Jenkins API that retrieves the list of jobs, saving the JSON output to '/home/ga/jenkins_jobs.json'. You are already logged in as admin. If prompted to log in, use Username: admin, Password: Admin123!
